title: 30 out-of-the-box Sacred Ground morning post concepts
hard_law: If another metaphysical store would logically use this image, REJECT.
follow_morning_rules: Idea first — the picture IS the idea (bar: Sep 20 birthday sun). Not a style slot. Not the same cream-pane factory every day.
Schedule type lives ON the photo — large, thick, mixed fonts. Soft cream wash OK. Never skinny colored bars under the photo.
Footer under the photo is ONLY shopsacredground.com + 847-749-3922 + circular logo.
Equal visual weight for 2–3 events. No hero + tiny secondary. No dollar prices. FREE ok.
Designed-in Chicagoland #1 / Premier / Voted pride baked into every NEW plate.
Colorful jewel / unexpected bold color. Ban drab, mystic AI wellness starter pack, Bauhaus, Victorian ledger.
Never reuse a used URL. One plate for FB+IG. Hold do_not_publish until Founder unlocks 9am.
founder_note_30: Normal Is Closed Today feels the most Sacred Ground — virtually no rules. Picture she already has: enormous amethyst geode in downtown Arlington Heights, tiny people around it, Sacred Ground glowing behind, morning sunlight, photoreal, absurd and beautiful.

oct3_keep.note: Founder keep: Harry Potter kids + barn owl shop. Do not replace. Castle is for the NIGHT storefront plate, not this morning. Date lives under the names so the owl stays visible.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Cosmic Newspaper
concepts.idea: Old-fashioned newspaper delivered from another dimension. Giant headline TODAY AT SACRED GROUND. Smaller stories are today's readers, healers, classes. 1940s paper meets galactic news.

concepts.label: The Metaphysical Price Is Right
concepts.idea: Wildly colorful 1970s game-show set. Crystal podiums reveal who's at Sacred Ground today. Campy, bright, deliberately over-the-top. No dollar prices on the graphic.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Tarot Billboard
concepts.idea: Enormous tarot card on a real Chicagoland highway billboard. The card changes every morning and represents the day. NEVER Death. Max 2 tarot-card plates per calendar month.

concepts.label: The Universe's Morning Meeting
concepts.idea: Aliens, angels, Bigfoot, a monk, an Egyptian deity and a Victorian ghost around a corporate conference table discussing today's Sacred Ground schedule. Hysterical; change the cast every use.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Dollhouse
concepts.idea: The entire store as an intricate miniature dollhouse. Tiny rooms: massage, Tarot, Reiki, crystals, meditation, classes. Rooms light up for what's happening that day.

concepts.label: 1970s Airline Advertisement
concepts.idea: Your Destination Today: Sacred Ground. Retro stewardess-era travel poster. Destinations are Reiki, Tarot, Sound Healing, crystals, meditation — not cities.

concepts.label: The Cosmic Convenience Store
concepts.idea: Sacred Ground as a strange late-night convenience store between Earth and the Pleiades. Instead of Slurpees: intuition, healing, crystals, Tarot, enlightenment.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Museum Exhibit
concepts.idea: Grand museum gallery. Tarot, crystals, bowls displayed as priceless antiquities. Velvet rope around TODAY'S EVENTS. Bright museum light — not Blade Runner mud.

concepts.label: The Metaphysical Vending Machine
concepts.idea: Giant gorgeous vintage vending machine. Buttons for Tarot, Reiki, Massage, Astrology, Sound Healing, Akashic. Today's offerings glow.

concepts.label: The Universe Is Calling
concepts.idea: Incredible vintage rotary telephone in a surreal landscape. Receiver floating. Cord into the stars. A different message from the Universe every day.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground After Dark — Morning Edition
concepts.idea: Film-noir detective scene. A Tarot card, crystal, or pendulum is the clue. 1940s B&W with ONE supernatural color element. Never Death.

concepts.label: Victorian Curiosity Cabinet
concepts.idea: Elaborate cabinet, dozens of drawers. Impossible contents: tiny galaxy, crystal cave, reader table, miniature moon. Today's drawers are open. Equal drawer size.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Trading Cards
concepts.idea: Practitioners as elaborate fantasy collector cards — not cheesy baseball. Special Ability / Power lines. Equal card size when 2–3 people share the day.

concepts.label: The Metaphysical Department Store Catalog
concepts.idea: 1960s Sears catalog gone metaphysical. Page 111: Things Your Soul Apparently Needs Today.

concepts.label: The Cosmic Diner
concepts.idea: Chrome 1950s diner floating in space. Menu board lists today's specials. Crystals instead of sugar dispensers.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground View-Master
concepts.idea: Giant vintage View-Master with the circular reel. Each frame is one thing happening today. Immediately recognizable.

concepts.label: The Universe's Lost & Found
concepts.idea: Surreal lost-and-found counter. Lost items: intuition, peace, direction, confidence, sleep, connection, wonder. Sacred Ground is where they came to retrieve them. Lost item can be funny, poignant, or spiritual — change it every morning.

concepts.label: Metaphysical Mugshots
concepts.idea: NOT practitioners as criminals. Crystals, decks, pendulums, bowls as cheeky vintage police mugshots. CHARGE: Disturbing the Ordinary.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Train Station
concepts.idea: Grand old European train terminal. Departure board: INTUITION, HEALING, CLARITY, REST, CONNECTION. Today's offerings appear as departures — schedule without looking like a calendar.

concepts.label: The Spiritual Emergency Room
concepts.idea: Whimsical, not medical. Crystal on a little hospital bed. Deck getting examined. Headline energy: Feeling energetically questionable?

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Record Album
concepts.idea: Every morning a different vintage album cover: psychedelic 60s, disco 70s, punk 80s, grunge 90s. Today's practitioners are the track list.

concepts.label: The Cosmic Laundromat
concepts.idea: Gorgeous retro laundromat at midnight. Galaxies spinning in washing machines. Sometimes your energy needs a wash cycle too.

concepts.label: The Metaphysical Pawn Shop
concepts.idea: Strange mystical storefront packed with impossible artifacts. Sign energy: We don't buy your stuff. We help you find yourself.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Action Figures
concepts.idea: Each practitioner a boxed collectible figure with accessories (deck, bowl, chart, table). Could become a whole practitioner campaign. Equal boxes.

concepts.label: The Universe's Waiting Room
concepts.idea: Angels, aliens, fairies, ghosts, monks, ordinary humans waiting for their Sacred Ground appointment. Number board: NOW SERVING 111.

concepts.label: Metaphysical Grocery Store
concepts.idea: Vintage grocery aisle. Jars labeled Courage, Intuition, Peace, Boundaries, Rest, Abundance, WTF Am I Doing With My Life.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground Through the Ages
concepts.idea: Every morning the shop exists in a different era: Ancient Egypt, Renaissance Florence, Victorian London, 1920s Paris, 1950s America, 1969 Woodstock, 1980s mall, year 3026. Real eggplant-awning storefront when a building appears.

concepts.label: The Sacred Ground Time Machine
concepts.idea: Giant elaborate Jules Verne-style machine. Destination dial points to TODAY. Through the portal: today's classes and practitioners.

concepts.label: Tiny People, Giant Crystals
concepts.idea: Photoreal miniature people climbing enormous amethyst cathedrals, polishing giant quartz, carrying Tarot like construction materials. Scale makes you stop.

concepts.label: Sacred Ground: Normal Is Closed Today
concepts.idea: Wildcard series. Deliberately impossible: crystal through a CTA train, Tarot raining over downtown Arlington Heights, gigantic singing bowl in the street, the Moon parked outside the shop, an angel at a crosswalk, a UFO dropping someone for an 11:00 Tarot. First build: amethyst geode in downtown AH.
